title: Platform configuration
description: Settings the task environment supplies. They bound what any registry entry may say, so a registry writer cannot widen them. This schema describes the configuration in its JSON form, which is how the configuration binder sees it; the deployed form is environment variables, where a colon becomes a double underscore (Policy:AllowedUpstreams:0 is Policy__AllowedUpstreams__0) and every value arrives as a string that the binder converts. Source: docs/plan/02-contracts.md -> Platform configuration. Freezes at G1a.
$comment: additionalProperties is true because the task environment also carries settings that are not the platform's (Logging, ASPNETCORE_*, OTEL_*). Every section the platform owns is closed.

Cell.description: The cell name. Part of every resource name and of the data-protection application name.

Key.description: The registry object's key, registry/registry.json in every environment so far.

PollSeconds.description: The conditional-GET interval, jittered by up to 20%.

Bucket.description: Where releases live. One bucket serves both in Phase 1.

Issuers.description: The issuers a registry entry may name, keyed by the name an entry uses in oauth.issuer. Assumption A4 is one issuer per environment.

Authority.description: The issuer the OpenID Connect handler discovers from.

x-freeze.note: The key is frozen at G1a. The permitted IIdpProfile.Name values belong to G1b, recorded by the annotated contracts-v1 tag (ADR-0017).

Profile.description: Which IIdpProfile applies. Set here, never in an entry.

BrowserOrigin.description: The origin the browser visits at the provider: scheme and authority only. It goes into form-action and is the base of Cognito's logout URL.

items.description: A suffix a registry host may end with, lowercase, including the port when hosts carry one.
An upstream origin an entry may name. Phase 2 uses https patterns only.
The ALB subnets, in CIDR form. Applied to KnownIPNetworks; KnownNetworks is obsolete in .NET 10.

Store.description: memory in Phase 1, dynamodb in Phase 2.

MaxSessions.description: The bound on the in-memory store.

TableName.description: The session table. Required when `Store` is `dynamodb`; ignored otherwise.
